name: √Letter -Root Letter-
source:
√Letter is the first entry in the publisher’s new series of mystery games. It’s a youth mystery adventure set in [url=https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shimane_Prefecture]Shimane Prefecture[/url] and features both adventure and simulation parts. [url=/s7588]Minoboshi Tarou[/url], [url=/v2099]Love Plus'[/url] character designer that left [url=/p77]Konami[/url] in March, is handling character designs and planning. The scenario is being handled by [url=/s9667]Fuji Dario[/url], and the music is by Nitta Takashi.

√Letter is set in Matsue, Shimane Prefecture, where the protagonist arrives in search of [url=/c43187]Fumino Aya[/url], a pen pal friend from high school who had disappeared for 15 years. After he finds a letter dedicated to him from her that was never sent, he sets out to interrogate her classmates as he wonders if everything Aya had told him had been a lie. The game contains multiple endings based on the player's choices throughout the game.

[Edited from [url=http://gematsu.com/2015/11/kadokawa-games-announces-root-letter-ps4-ps-vita]Gematsu[/url] and [url=https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Root_Letter]Wikipedia[/url]]
